years_since_diagnosis.evidence: diagnosed with Crohn's three years ago

location.evidence: Colonoscopy and MRI enterography showed extensive small bowel disease

severity.evidence: Extensive small bowel disease, severe weight loss, GI doctor recommended biologics immediately given age and disease extent, still has breakthrough symptoms on Entyvio

disease_control.evidence: Been stable-ish for 18 months. Still have breakthrough symptoms, especially during stress.

treatments.reason_stopped: Side effects (moon face, insomnia, mood swings); tapered off after three months
treatments.evidence: Started aggressively with prednisone and azathioprine combination. Prednisone gave me moon face, insomnia, mood swings. Tapered off after three months.
Started Entyvio as insurance covered it better than others. Infusion every 8 weeks. Been stable-ish for 18 months. Still have breakthrough symptoms.

encounters.evidence: Doctors always attributed my symptoms to fibro or thyroid issues — implies prior PCP/general care before GI referral
Finally, severe weight loss and persistent diarrhea led to proper GI workup. GI doctor recommended biologics immediately given my age and disease extent. Started Entyvio.

status.evidence: Started Entyvio as insurance covered it better than others. Infusion every 8 weeks isn't terrible.

barriers.evidence: Started Entyvio as insurance covered it better than others — implies insurance preference/formulary drove the choice among biologics, suggesting prior authorization/coverage constraints

referral_steps_gp_to_prescriber.evidence: PCP/prior doctors (step 1) -> GI specialist who prescribed Entyvio (step 2)

extraction_notes: Patient is currently on Entyvio (vedolizumab) with partial control; next appointment will discuss adding an immunomodulator. Supplements (vitamin D, etc.) and medications for hypothyroidism, fibromyalgia, and osteoporosis excluded from treatments per schema rules. Osteoporosis noted as comorbidity (likely steroid-related but also stated as a separate developing condition). Barriers_status set to inferred because the insurance preference for Entyvio over other biologics implies a coverage/formulary barrier that was overcome, but no explicit denial was stated.
